title: SK Hyper Seeks $350B for South Korea AI Infrastructure
summary:
Industry concerns regarding the future demand for artificial intelligence have not slowed the global drive to build the massive physical capacity required to run it. SK Hyper is currently negotiating with big tech firms and financial investors to secure $350 billion in funding for a large-scale data center buildout in South Korea to expand regional AI infrastructure.

The project's ambition reflects a wider competitive rush among developers to roll out hardware to support generative AI models. SK Hyper intends to rely on a combination of strategic technology partnerships and capital from financial institutions to bankroll the network of facilities.
